children.text: Polycarp's phone book contains $$$n$$$ phone numbers, each of them is described by $$$s_i$$$ — the number itself and $$$m_i$$$ — the number of times Polycarp dials it in daily.
Polycarp has just bought a brand new phone with an amazing

feature! More precisely, $$$k$$$ buttons on it can have a number assigned to it (not necessary from the phone book). To enter some number Polycarp can press one of these $$$k$$$ buttons and then finish the number using usual digit buttons (entering a number with only digit buttons is also possible).
